features: 【Unique Canvas Prints】Turn your favorite photos into beautiful canvas prints with your photos that will last a lifetime. As soon as you install this wall canvas painting on your wall, you will make your moments unforgettable with this painting picture.

【Personalized with Your Photos】Prints your own pets or family or friends or anything you like, capture those fond memories, and make them into unique canvas wall art. They Will Be Also Great Gift For Engagement, Graduation, Baby Shower, Anniversary and Other Special Days or Celebrations.

【Premium Materials】Fine workmanship and materials are the guarantee of quality. We use the latest ink water, bright and colorful, environmentally friendly, waterproof, anti-ultraviolet, and Gallery Wrapped, Stretched by Professionals and Printing with Latex Ink by using latest technology to make your Photo Canvas Prints Reliable.

【Best Effect Reminder】After uploading a custom photo, make sure the image you specify covers any white space and has no white space . Otherwise, your photo may be drastically cropped or stretched to fit the entire canvas surface. For best results, upload high-resolution images, as the clarity of your canvas print is directly related to the quality of your photo.
